request.description: Execute a batch of 1–5 MCP tool calls. Calls run concurrently and each result reports its own `status`. When Gumloop accepts the request, MCP execution failures such as target server authentication, policy blocks, invalid tools, upstream HTTP errors, and connection failures are returned in `results[*].status` and `results[*].error`. Top-level `4xx` responses are reserved for Gumloop request, authentication, and permission failures. `200` covers homogeneous execution outcomes (all calls succeeded or all calls failed); mixed success/failure batches return `207`. If you previously treated non-2xx HTTP statuses as MCP execution failures, update your integration to inspect each result's `status` and `error`.

response.name: Batch processed. Inspect each result's `status` and `error`; this can include all-success and all-failed execution outcomes.
